new_findings.title: Past-due usage is presented with a Ready status tone
new_findings.defect: A positive-remaining past_due response falls through to mode default, which maps to the ok tone. StatusMessage renders that tone as acx-status-ok with a Ready icon title, contradicting the grace-only status copy.
new_findings.failure_scenario: GET /portal/usage returns status='past_due' and remaining=2; the message says remaining access follows backend grace only, while the status indicator is green/Ready.
new_findings.fix: Map past_due responses to the info tone and extend the past-due journey assertion to require the info status class.
